newsitem.title: USA: Sovereign sets stock split, ups dividend.
newsitem.headline: Sovereign sets stock split, ups dividend.

text.p: Sovereign Bancorp Inc on Thursday said its board of directors declared a six-for-five stock split on its common stock and would increase its cash dividend by 15 percent.

The company said in a statement that as a result of the stock dividend, the common shares outstanding would increase to about 60 million. Fully diluted common shares outstanding will increase to about 72 million.

The common stock split will be in the form of one new share of common stock distributed for every five shares of common stock owned and a check payable to the shareholder for any fractional shares created by the dividend. The extra shares will be distributed on Feb 14 to common stock shareholders of record on Jan 28.
Chairman Richard Mohn said the board had voted to increase the quarterly cash dividend on the common stock from $0.0175, adjusted for the six-for-five split, to $0.02 per share.
The dividend is payable on Feb 14 to shareholders of record on Jan 29.
